page_title: NIC 0-0 CLE | Nice v Clermont 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Khephren Thuram (Nice), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
86' Florent Ogier (Clermont) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
82' Francesco Farioli decides to make a substitution. Alexis Claude-Maurice will be replaced by Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice).
82' Substitution. Bilal Boutobba leaves the pitch and is replaced by Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont).
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.
75' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
74' The game has come to an end for Jordan Lotomba. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Valentin Rosier (Nice).
73' It is time for a substitution. Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is on for Mohamed-Ali Cho.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yohan Magnin (Clermont) replaces Johan Gastien.
73' Here is a change. Shamar Nicholson is going off and Pascal Gastien gives the last tactical orders to Komnen Andric (Clermont).
70' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
67' That's unlucky! Alan Virginius (Clermont) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
66' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pablo Rosario (Nice) is coming onto the pitch as Hicham Boudaoui cannot continue after picking up an injury.
61' Francesco Farioli prepares a substitution. Jeremie Boga is replaced by Terem Moffi (Nice).
61' That will be all from Jim Allevinah who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alan Virginius (Clermont).
60' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Hakim Ben El Hadj has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
56' Evann Guessand (Nice) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Mory Diaw makes a great save to stop his effort.
52' Nice have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Clermont can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
46' Pascal Gastien makes a switch. Habib Keita (Clermont) is coming on in place of Maxime Gonalons at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Penalty saved! Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) sends the penalty towards the right hand side of the goal, but Marcin Bulka pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
45+5' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+4' Today's referee Hakim Ben El Hadj rightly decides to book Dante (Nice) for his harsh tackle.
45+4' It’s a PENALTY to Clermont after the VAR review!

45+4' Play continues despite the shouts by some Clermont players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
45+1' PENALTY APPEAL by Clermont, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Marcin Bulka.

41' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mory Diaw pulls off an easy save.
39' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
37' Nice earn a corner.
33' Florent Ogier (Clermont) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj saw the whole situation.
30' Hakim Ben El Hadj shows the yellow card to Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) for a heavy challenge.
27' Evann Guessand (Nice) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
27' Nice take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
25' Florent Ogier (Clermont) makes a strong challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows for a foul.

22' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. His dangerous effort is blocked by Marcin Bulka, who makes a glorious save!
20' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
17' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
11' Nice take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
8' Hakim Ben El Hadj shows a yellow card to Khephren Thuram (Nice), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
5' Khephren Thuram (Nice) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
4' Khephren Thuram (Nice) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
1' The first half has just begun.
Nice will kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj was nominated as the referee for this game.
